# Mind and Soul Community Connection

> A community-based not-for-profit organization in Milton, Ontario, Canada, dedicated to promoting emotional well-being, mental health and meaningful connection. Tagline: "Supporting Wellness, Strengthening Community."

Mind and Soul Community Connection works to make overall wellness, mental health support, education and community programs more accessible through workshops, support initiatives, community events and collaborative partnerships. Its work is guided by compassion, respect, inclusion and integrity, and it welcomes individuals and families from all backgrounds, cultures and stages of life.

- Location: Milton, Ontario, Canada
- Email: mindandsoulcommunityconnection@gmail.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/1E8kcBUDrt/
- Website: https://mindandsoulconnection.ca/

## Programs

- Mental health and wellness workshops: webinars and workshops that promote awareness, provide practical tools and encourage open conversations about mental health, emotional well-being and everyday wellness.
- Community connections: events and gatherings that bring people together, build relationships, reduce isolation and strengthen a sense of belonging. Past events include a Mom's Meetup and Breakfast and Connections in Milton.
- Support groups (in development): safe, welcoming spaces to share experiences and develop practical coping skills.
- Individual mental health support (in development): accessible one-on-one counselling.

## Get involved

- Volunteer: help with event coordination, outreach, facilitation and day-of logistics. No experience required.
- Collaborate: partnerships with organizations, practitioners and local groups for workshops, referrals, joint events or resource sharing.
- Join the community: gatherings, support groups and meetups. Everyone is welcome.
